units.export_scale: baked x100 in a temporary export scene; FBX unit scale 1; no import scale needed

axes.blender: Z up, character faces +X, character left = +Y, ground origin between the feet
axes.unreal: Z up, character faces +X, character left = -Y (Unreal receives Blender (x, y, z) as (x, -y, z))

bone_frame: local Y runs head->tail; local Z is the flexion-direction hint; local X = Y x Z. +X rotation is forward flexion for spine, limbs and head; right-side bones are exact X-mirrors of the left side.
root: single root bone `root`, identity-oriented, independent of pelvis; carries root motion (dash clips)

bones.name: root
bones.note: single stable root, identity-oriented: local axes = character axes; carries root motion

bones.name: jaw
bones.note: jaw pivot near the ear line

bones.name: lid_up_l
bones.note: upper lid, pivots about the eyeball centre

bones.name: lid_lo_l
bones.note: lower lid, pivots about the eyeball centre

bones.name: lid_up_r
bones.note: upper lid, pivots about the eyeball centre

bones.name: lid_lo_r
bones.note: lower lid, pivots about the eyeball centre

bones.name: blade
bones.note: retractable forearm blade; extend by translating along local Y

bones.name: prop_cell
bones.note: power cell prop bone (character-space); keys follow the forearm slot, hand or pouch

bones.name: prop_beacon
bones.note: beacon/drone prop bone (character-space); keys follow the dock, the right hand or the floor

sockets.name: hand_grip_l
sockets.purpose: left palm grip point (fingers along forward)

sockets.name: blade_tip
sockets.purpose: blade tip (retracted position, moves with the blade bone)

sockets.name: cell_slot
sockets.purpose: power cell slot on the cybernetic forearm

sockets.name: prop_cell
sockets.purpose: centre of the power cell prop (mesh is Z-up authored: axes = character axes at rest)

sockets.name: prop_beacon
sockets.purpose: base centre of the beacon prop (mesh is Z-up authored)

sockets.name: cam_face
sockets.purpose: close-up camera anchor in front of the face (looks back at the face)

sockets.name: floor_l
sockets.purpose: ground contact reference under the left ankle

sockets.name: floor_r
sockets.purpose: ground contact reference under the right ankle

face_bones.jaw: open = negative local X rotation (up to about 24 degrees)
face_bones.eye_l/eye_r: rot X = pitch up, rot Z = yaw left
face_bones.lid_up_*: closes with negative local X rotation about the eyeball centre
face_bones.lid_lo_*: closes with positive local X rotation
face_bones.tongue_01..03: negative local X lifts the tongue
